source.tree_layout: u16 pairs at tree + (node-0x100)*4 and +2; root 0x100; any value below 0x100 is a literal byte
source.bit_order: low bit first, fresh byte every 8 (0x0205CD8C)

note:
Decode the game's Huffman string bank - every UI string, by id.

WHY THIS MATTERS. The standing rule is that anything the port shows which is not
one of the game's own strings is an ADDITION, not parity. Until now only the
handful of strings a write-watchpoint happened to catch were known, so that rule
could not actually be checked. This decodes the bank.

THE DECODER is at 0x0205CD20 (its push; 0x0205CD70 is mid-loop). Its control
block is the literal at 0x0205CE18 = 0x020FE5C8, and the block is filled at load
- it reads zero in the static image, so this works from rebuilt RAM:

    [0x020FE5C8 + 0]   the OFFSET TABLE, indexed by string id * 4
    [0x020FE5C8 + 4]   the compressed DATA base
    [0x020FE5C8 + 8]   the HUFFMAN TREE base

THE TREE is u16 pairs. From the loop:

    0x0205CD74  add    r7, r6, sb, lsl #2
    0x0205CD78  subne  r7, r7, #0x300        bit set
    0x0205CD7C  ldrhne sb, [r7, #-0xfe]      -> tree + node*4 - 0x3FE
    0x0205CD80  subeq  r7, r7, #0x400        bit clear
    0x0205CD88  ldrheq sb, [r7]              -> tree + node*4 - 0x400

so node n has its two children at tree + (n - 0x100)*4 and +2, the root is
0x100, and any value below 0x100 is a literal byte. Bits are taken LOW FIRST -
`asr r7, r3, r0` then `tst r7, #1` with r0 counting 0..7 - and a fresh byte is
fetched when r0 reaches 8 (0x0205CD8C `cmp r0,#8` / `ldrbeq r3,[r4],#1`).
A decoded byte of 0 ends the string.

IT SELF-VALIDATES, which is why it can be trusted without a second source.
Character names are string 0x1CB + character id, and decoding those reproduces
config/menu_screens.json's independently-captured list exactly - 0x1DF "Greedo",
0x1D2 "Boba Fett", 0x1E8 "Jango Fett", 0x1ED "Lando Jabba's Palace". Strings
0x293 "@1 - @2" and 0x294 "????" likewise match what
character_select_overlay.gd already recorded from a framebuffer capture.

Usage:  python tools/export_strings.py

strings.0x2E4: It is a period of civil war. Rebel spaceships, striking from a hidden base, have won their first victory against the evil Galactic Empire.
strings.0x2E5: During the battle, Rebel spies managed to steal secret plans to the Empire's ultimate weapon, the DEATH STAR, an armored space station with enough power to destroy an entire planet.
strings.0x2E6: Pursued by the Empire's sinister agents, Princess Leia races home aboard her starship, custodian of the stolen plans that can save her people and restore freedom to the galaxy....
strings.0x2EA: Young Luke Skywalker, unaware of the great destiny which lies before him, leaves for Mos Eisley Space Port in search for answers to the questions his new droids have brought.
strings.0x2EB: Here, among the most dangerous and reckless elements of Tatooine society, they hope to find someone brave or foolhardy enough to help in their quest to deliver R2-D2's secret data to the Rebel Alliance.
strings.0x2F0: Imprisoned in the Death Star, Princess Leia still refuses to reveal the location of the Rebel Base to the evil Darth Vader.
strings.0x2F1: Meanwhile, Luke Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi have commissioned Han Solo to take them to Leia's home planet of Alderaan. Escaping from Imperial Forces on Tatooine, they make the jump through hyperspace.
strings.0x2F2: But Alderaan has disappeared, its population a victim of Darth Vader's impatience - and in its place, they find only the deadly shadow of the Death Star...
strings.0x2F6: Luke Skywalker, Han Solo and Chewbacca have rescued Princess Leia from the clutches of Darth Vader and his Imperial forces - but must now find a way out of the Death Star.
strings.0x2F7: Aided by the droid R2-D2, who can interface remotely with the Death Star control systems, they battle their way to the Millennium Falcon.
strings.0x2F8: Meanwhile, the Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi moves closer to his final destiny...
strings.0x2FC: With the Death Star plans in their hands at last, the Rebel Alliance plans a desperate assault on the Imperial space station.
strings.0x2FD: But a hidden homing beacon attached to the Millennium Falcon has led Darth Vader to the rebel's secret base on the moon of Yavin IV. The moon will soon be in range of the mighty Death Star's superlaser.
strings.0x2FE: Now, a small band of fearless pilots bear with them the hopes of an entire galaxy...
strings.0x302: It is a dark time for the Rebellion. Although the Death Star has been destroyed, Imperial troops have driven the Rebel forces from their hidden base and pursued them across the galaxy.
strings.0x303: Evading the dreaded Imperial Starfleet, a group of freedom fighters led by Luke Skywalker has established a new secret base on the remote ice world of Hoth.
strings.0x304: The evil lord Darth Vader, obsessed with finding young Skywalker, has dispatched thousands of remote probes into the far reaches of space...
strings.0x308: Imperial forces have mounted a relentless assault on the rebel base on Hoth. The rebel fighters have held out bravely, but the enemy is overwhelming.
strings.0x309: In the Echo base command center, carved deep into the ice of the frozen planet, Han Solo and Princess Leia monitor the evacuation of rebel personnel.
strings.0x30A: But as stormtroopers breach the outer defences, they must quickly find an escape route for themselves...
strings.0x30E: Led by the evil Darth Vader, Imperial forces have overrun the rebel base on the ice planet Hoth.
strings.0x30F: Having bravely stalled the enemy advance, Luke Skywalker has made his escape by X-Wing fighter.
strings.0x310: And as the last rebel transports lift off from the planet, Han Solo in the Millennium Falcon engages the Imperial ships above...
strings.0x314: Escaping from the Rebel defeat on Hoth, Han Solo has sought sanctuary on Cloud City, high above the planet Bespin.
strings.0x315: His old friend Lando Calrissian is now Baron-Administrator of this self-governing colony, and Han hopes for a warm welcome.
strings.0x316: But in this time of galactic upheaval, nothing is as it seems...
strings.0x31A: Barely a few weeks into his Jedi training, Luke Skywalker has had a vision of his friends captured by Darth Vader.
strings.0x31B: Against prudence, the impetuous young Jedi sets his X-Wing fighter on a course for Cloud City.
strings.0x31C: Here he hopes to find Han Solo and Princess Leia - never guessing in his haste that he himself is the true target of Vader's trap...
strings.0x320: Luke Skywalker has returned to his home planet of Tatooine in an attempt to rescue his friend Han Solo from the clutches of the vile gangster Jabba the Hutt.
strings.0x321: Little does Luke know that the Galactic Empire has secretly begun construction on a new armored space station even more powerful than the first dreaded Death Star.
strings.0x322: When completed, this ultimate weapon will spell certain doom for the small band of rebels struggling to restore freedom to the galaxy...
strings.0x326: Work continues on the new Death Star, and future of the galaxy appears increasingly bleak.
strings.0x327: On Tatooine, Luke Skywalker is in the grip of Jabba the Hutt, along with Han Solo, Chewbacca and Princess Leia. Jabba takes his prisoners across the Tatooine dunes to the Great Pit of Carkoon, where he plans to feed them to the fearsome Sarlacc beast.
strings.0x328: But, even with back-up from Boba Fett, Jabba has severely underestimated the powers of a Jedi...
strings.0x32C: The Rebel Alliance has learned of the new Death Star, and launches a daring plan to destroy this evil weapon before its construction can be completed.
strings.0x32D: The Rebel fleet is readied for an assault, and a small strike unit lands on the nearby forest moon of Endor.
strings.0x32E: Led by Luke Skywalker and Han Solo, their mission is to destroy the shield generator which protects the deadly Imperial space station...
strings.0x332: As the Rebel fleet draws closer to the Death Star, Luke Skywalker has turned himself over to Imperial forces and heads to the Death Star for a final confrontation with Darth Vader.
strings.0x333: The commando team led by Han Solo makes its way towards the Imperial shield generator on Endor. But the rebel forces are lured into a trap. Although it appears incomplete, the Death Star is already fully functional.
strings.0x334: And a deadly surprise lies in wait for the intrepid rebel strike team...
strings.0x338: With help from the Ewoks, the rebels have finally managed to destroy the Death Star shield generator on Endor.
strings.0x339: In the sky above, the Rebel fleet has come under intense fire from Imperial craft and the Death Star itself. Many ships have been destroyed.
strings.0x33A: But General Lando Calrissian is now able to lead the final assault on the Empire's ultimate weapon, and pilot the Millennium Falcon deep into its dark heart...
strings.0x33E: As the battle between Imperial and Rebel forces rages around the second Death Star, Luke Skywalker confronts Darth Vader - his father, once Anakin Skywalker.
strings.0x33F: From boy slave on Tatooine, to hero of the Clone Wars, to Sith Lord, feared throughout the galaxy, Anakin Skywalker's path has been dark indeed.
strings.0x340: In front of Emperor Palpatine, his villainous master, Vader must now face his son, and reclaim his fate...
strings.0x344: An even longer time ago, in a galaxy far, far, away....
strings.0x345: It is a period of peace and tranquility. The galaxy sits in the throes of infancy as the CREATORS breathe life into the barren sand.
strings.0x346: What will rise from the primordial sand? What surprises await the intrepid explorers? The face of creation can be changed...
